mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 290 signals elevated inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 290.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is strong (PAYEMS > 150000) and housing demand is weak (HOUST < 1750), it signals an economic imbalance that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000 and HOUST < 1750.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by GDP growth above 3% (GDPC1 > 19700) and inflation above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 290), the market is overvalued, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 19700 and CPIAUCSL > 290.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.5 (index 2017=100) signals weakening economic activity, prompting risk-off sentiment that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105.5.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness condition (UNRATE < 4.0) signals potential for monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines by at least 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 700000 (millions of dollars) signals an overbought market condition, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 700000.
